title: To do list app
body: I like this app very much so, very simple yet effective. If there was one thing I would change it would be for the titles  (e.g today, tomorrow, later) could be customisable as well as the colour scheme :)
author: sasa :)..

title: so fun for my stupid brain
body: i forget everything all the time so much better than reminders on iphone and so cute easy layout no ads etc looks so cute as a widget
author: ilyboo0

title: Great app, easy to use!
body: Very helpful app that included useful features. You can add different accounts for different tasks. Definitely a must have for busy people and keeping your life on track! Sadly you have to pay for some feature such as reminders or reoccurring events. Would be even better free!
author: 1324566ujbdqhyjew mncs

title: Great to do app
body: Nice clean look but plenty of features. Love the logbook and search functions. Easy to set up and use.
author: DeyaraNZ

title: So far so good
body: Just enough functionality to make the app work well without being over complicated. No bugs or glitches after a week of use and I’m getting more tasks checked off than I was without the app so that’s got to be a win
